output.reason: [ev-dea2079e5dc4] says earlier chart values enabled policy exceptions in all namespaces by default, and that the change affects users who relied on that. [ev-2bbc505de6bb] says these users must set `features.policyExceptions.namespace` to `*` to keep the old behaviour. So the exposed environments are those that leave the key unset and use PolicyExceptions. An environment that sets the key has chosen its own value and is shielded from the default change. The upstream cluster also includes a separate change, the removal of wildcard view permissions [ev-01e97dc9c4df]. The fixed subject leaves that change out, which is why confidence is low.
